prep.notes: Extracted latest monthly population for each village (里) from the age-distribution table, keeping only the '計' (total) category. Joined with village boundary data to obtain center coordinates using prep.match on normalized village and district names. Converted projected coordinates (TWD97) to WGS84 lat/lon. Computed 1km coverage matrix based on straight-line distance between village centers. Used district+village name combination as unique candidate ID to avoid duplicates.
